description: STAT, the statistics department of Sint Maarten, publishes the main results of the 2011 Population and Housing Census as a PDF of 235 pages. Its housing chapter has seventeen tables of living accommodations: type, quality rated appropriate, bad or very bad, outer wall and roof material, period built from before 1950, ownership and rent, bedrooms and floor area, bathrooms and toilets, and toilet drainage into cesspools, septic tanks or the sewer. Water tables separate the public supply line from cisterns or wells, water trucks and bottled water, and count wells with electric pumps. The electricity table shows 96.6 percent of occupied accommodations on the grid and about two percent on their own generator, with a solar or wind category. Other tables cover cooking energy, cars, air-conditioning units and phones, computers and internet. The 2022 census general findings, 66 pages, give population by district and household spending on electricity, water and telecoms. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: none found. Caveats: housing tables are national only and date from 2011, and the older stat.gov.sx host did not respond. Simulation uses: cistern reliance and roof materials for hurricane and drought exposure, and generator use for grid resilience studies. Related records: none closer in the catalogue.
